mapper.select: select U.USER_NO userNo, U.USER_NAME userName, U.EMAIL email, U.PROFILEIMAGE profileImage, R.RANK_NAME rankName, P.POSITION_NAME positionName, O.ORGANIZATION_NAME organizaionName FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN TITLE T ON U.USER_NO = T.USER_NO LEFT JOIN RANK R ON T.RANK_NO = R.RANK_NO LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON T.POSITION_NO = P.POSITION_NO LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATION O ON U.USER_NO = O.USER_NO WHERE U.COMPANY_NO = #{ companyNo }
SELECT GROUPS_NO groupsNo, GROUPS_NAME groupsName FROM GROUPS WHERE GROUPS_NO IN (SELECT GROUPS_NO FROM GROUPSMEMBER WHERE GRP_MEMBER_NO = #{ userNo })
SELECT ORGANIZATION_NO organizationNo, ORGANIZATION_NAME organizationName FROM ORGANIZATION WHERE ORGANIZATION_NO IN (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NO FROM ORGANIZATIONMEMBER WHERE ORGMEMBER_NO = #{ userNo })

SELECT U.USER_NAME userName, U.EMAIL email, U.PROFILEIMAGE profileImage, R.RANK_NAME rankName, P.POSITION_NAME positionName, O.ORGANIZATION_NAME organizaionName, COMPANY_NAME companyName FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN COMPANY C ON U.COMPANY_NO = C.COMPANY_NO LEFT JOIN TITLE T ON U.USER_NO = T.USER_NO LEFT JOIN RANK R ON T.RANK_NO = R.RANK_NO LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON T.POSITION_NO = P.POSITION_NO LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATION O ON U.USER_NO = O.USER_NO WHERE U.USER_NO = #{ userNo }
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADDRBOOKMARK(TARGET_NO, USER_NO) VALUES(#{ userNo }, #{ targetNo })
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ADDRBOOKMARK WHERE TARGET_NO = #{ targetNo } AND USER_NO = #{ userNo }
